_note: Which Bridge-to-Grade-6 lessons support which Grade 6 standard. PROPOSED — needs a teacher's review before it is treated as authoritative; see _status.
_why: The bridge/catch-up track holds 38 level-0 (IEP / most-supported) resources, and every one of them is tagged FOUNDATIONAL — attached to no Grade 6 standard. So a per-standard view reports 'no level-0 support' for 34 of 42 standards while a whole shelf of it sits outside the join, invisible to anyone reading the coverage report to decide what to build next.

These lessons are PREREQUISITES, not level-0 versions of the standard. R5 Lesson 2 (Rates & Unit Rates) is what a student needs before 6.AT.A.2, not a supported way through it. Recording them as level-0 content FOR the standard would swap one overstatement for another, so they are reported in their own column and the no-level-0 flag stays truthful.
Mapping is by prerequisite relationship, from lesson titles and the R-unit structure. A teacher should confirm each row: this is the judgement call the data cannot make.
